About the Project

Reading's Mathematics for our Future Climate CDT supports doctoral work on mathematical questions connected to climate. Applicants join a research training programme where mathematical methods are developed and applied to climate processes and future environmental change. This PhD opening at University of Reading centres on Mathematics for our Future Climate CDT PhD, Reading 2027. Disciplinary scope: Mathematics, Climate Change. The role is based in Reading, United Kingdom. Funding is partial; financial support is listed as £30,000/year. Interested candidates should note the deadline: 8 November 2026.

Research Areas

  • Mathematics
  • Climate science
  • Environmental modelling

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryHome: GBP 30,000/year; other stipend GBP 23,805/year (2026/27)
TuitionInternational applicants must cover the international/home fee difference

Eligibility and Requirements

Eligibility depends on fee status: applicants who meet the requirements for home-fee status compete as home students, while all others are classified as international students. Both groups can be considered unless the project notice says otherwise.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round8 November 2026 first round; 10 January 2027 second round
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Reading

Reading hosts research in mathematics, climate and other disciplines. Its Mathematics for our Future Climate doctoral training programme combines mathematical research with questions about climate processes and future environmental change.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.reading.ac.uk/maths-and-stats/phd/mathematics-for-our-future-climate

Source: reading.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 8 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 8 November 2026 first round; 10 January 2027 second round. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
